headline: Aster DM Healthcare receives NCLT sanction order for Scheme of Amalgamation
sum: Aster DM Healthcare has obtained certified NCLT order sanctioning a Scheme of Amalgamation, signalling completion of judicial approval for the merger or consolidation transaction and triggering final regulatory milestones before implementation.
implication: NCLT sanction concludes the judicial gate; the company must now comply with post-sanction filing obligations (CIR filing, stock exchange intimation protocol, and creditor/shareholder communication requirements under the Companies Act 2013) before operational merger becomes effective.
detail: The National Company Law Tribunal has issued and certified the amalgamation order, which has been formally received by Aster DM Healthcare Limited. This marks the transition from scheme approval to the filing and implementation phase. Under Section 230–232 of the Companies Act 2013, NCLT sanction is the critical approval gate; once certified, the scheme must be filed with the Registrar of Companies (ROC) before the merger becomes operational. The company has simultaneously intimated the NSE, signalling compliance with stock exchange continuous disclosure norms.
